situation: Multiple clients request the same uncached expensive MCP operation (cache stampede).
decision: Use request coalescing / single-flight: one pod computes a miss while the others wait.
reasoning_physics: Under a stampede N identical misses each re-derive the full cost; single-flight collapses N to 1 compute while queuing waiters, reducing origin load ~N-fold. Cost saved per request becomes a measured metric.
